_comment: Levels. objective.type: score | tricks | pickups | timeTrial | grindDistance. stars = thresholds for 1, 2, 3 stars (for timeTrial: max seconds, lower is better). unlock: { totalStars } (total stars needed) and/or { level, levelStars } (that level with at least levelStars stars, default 1). pickups: 'all' | 'none' | [ids]. Adding a level here needs no code changes.

levels.name: First Push
levels.description: Score points on Maple Street. Ollie, flip and spin to build combos.

levels.name: Bolt Run
levels.description: Collect the bolts scattered around the street. Some need an ollie or a ramp.

levels.name: Curb Appeal
levels.description: Land clean tricks. Any landed trick or grind counts.

levels.name: Paperboy Sprint
levels.description: Race through the checkpoints: east end of the cross street, then the cul-de-sac.

levels.name: Park Rat
levels.description: Show the locals what you have got. Bowls and the half pipe give big airs.

levels.name: Rail Yard
levels.description: Grind rails, ledges and benches. Total grind distance counts.

levels.name: Bowl Hunter
levels.description: Bolts hide in the bowls, over the kickers and along the rails.

levels.name: Line Up
levels.description: Checkpoint run: the stair set, the north quarter pipe, then the big bowl.

levels.name: Step Up
levels.description: Land clean tricks around the plaza stairs and benches.

levels.name: Handrail Hero
levels.description: Grind the handrails, ledges and benches of the plaza.

levels.name: Plaza Sweep
levels.description: Collect the bolts on benches, ledges and the terrace.

levels.name: Plaza Masters
levels.description: A big score attack. Chain grinds and flips into long combos.

levels.name: Bomb the Hill
levels.description: Race from uptown down the hill: terrace checkpoint, then the plaza at the bottom.

levels.name: Downtown Hustle
levels.description: Use the hill's speed for huge airs. Score attack.

levels.name: Uptown Funk
levels.description: Every bolt in downtown, from the uptown ledges to the loading dock.

levels.name: Grind City
levels.description: Grind the city: rails, ledges, benches and the dock handrails.
